description:
Calling all innovators - find your future at Fiserv. 
 
 We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants and consumers to one another millions of times a day - quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
 
 
 Job Title 
Full Stack Software Engineer 
 
 About your role: 
 As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you will be part of our Merchant Solutions Risk & Fraud full-stack application development engineering group, responsible for mission-critical platforms that help Fiserv reduce financial and operational risk.
 Our team builds and supports highly scalable, available, and high-performing applications that enable risk-management processes and provide capabilities to monitor and manage merchant portfolios. We also develop solutions to onboard new clients, perform compliance and risk screening, and monitor card- and merchant-related fraud scenarios.
  
 This is a demanding, fast-paced environment requiring strong analytical and problem-solving skills. You will balance platform stability, resiliency, security, and performance with the adoption of modern engineering, cloud, automation, and AI technologies.
  
 What you'll do: 
 Design, develop, test, and implement full-stack solutions supporting critical Merchant Risk and Fraud business functions. 
 Develop highly scalable applications using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, Angular, and TypeScript. 
 Build and support low-latency, high-volume APIs and services operating 24x7 to support mission-critical business processes. 
 Drive modernization and migration of applications to AWS, leveraging Docker, ECS, Fargate, ECR, Application Load Balancer, IAM, CloudWatch, and Secrets Manager. 
 Leverage comparable Microsoft Azure capabilities, including Azure Container Apps, Azure Container Registry (ACR), and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). 
 Develop data-driven solutions using PostgreSQL, Snowflake, and SQL. 
 Build automation and operational tooling using Python and/or Shell scripting. 
 Contribute to Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, including LLM integration, AI agents, prompt engineering, tool/function calling, and AI orchestration. 
 Implement and support CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation, monitoring, and DevOps/DevSecOps practices. 
 Integrate security into the development lifecycle using Fortify, Sonatype, and Wiz for application, dependency, container, and cloud vulnerability identification and remediation. 
 Troubleshoot application performance and production issues across application, database, container, and cloud layers. 
 Collaborate with product owners, project managers, business stakeholders, architects, and other engineers throughout design, development, testing, and deployment. 
 Participate in code and design reviews and help establish engineering standards and best practices. 
 Work within an Agile/Scrum development environment while adapting quickly to changing business and project requirements. 
 
 Experience you'll need to have: 
 4+ years of software development experience 
 4+ years of experience with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices. 
 4+ years of hands-on experience with SQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB and Snowflake. 
 4+ years of experience developing and deploying containerized applications using Docker. 
 4+ years of hands-on experience with AWS, particularly ECS, Fargate, ECR, Application Load Balancer, IAM, CloudWatch, and Secrets Manager. 
 2+ years of experience developing front-end applications using Angular and TypeScript. 
 2+ years of experience with Python and/or Shell scripting for automation and operational support. 
 2+ years of experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, automated testing, and DevOps practices. 
 2+ years of experience with application monitoring, debugging, performance troubleshooting, and production support. 
 1+ years of experience working within an Agile/Scrum development environment. 
 1+ years of experience with application and cloud security tools, including Fortify, Sonatype, and Wiz, with an understanding of vulnerability identification and remediation. 
 1+ years of experience addressing application-code vulnerabilities, open-source dependency vulnerabilities, container/image vulnerabilities, and cloud security findings. 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience. 
   
 Experience that would be great to have: 
 Experience with Generative AI and Agentic AI, including LLM-based applications, AI agents, prompt engineering, tool/function calling, or AI orchestration. 
 Experience with Microsoft Azure container technologies such as Azure Container Apps, ACR, and AKS. 
 Experience with application and cloud security tools including Fortify, Sonatype, and Wiz. 
 Understanding of DevSecOps, secure coding, open-source dependency management, vulnerability identification, and remediation. 
 Experience with AWS and Azure cloud-native architectures. 
 Experience building or supporting high-volume, low-latency, 24x7 production systems. 
 Experience with JUnit, Mockito, Maven, Postman, JMeter, JIRA, and Git. 
 Experience in the payments, merchant acquiring, financial services, risk, compliance, or fraud domain. 
 
 Important information about this role: 
 You must currently possess valid and unrestricted U.S. work authorization to be considered for this role. Individuals with temporary visas including, but not limited to, F-1 (OPT, CPT, STEM), H-1B, H-2, or TN, or any candidate requiring sponsorship, now or in the future, will not be considered for this role.
 This is a full-time, direct-hire position, and no contract options for unsolicited agency submissions will be considered.
 All offers of employment are contingent on standard background checks. Fiserv and certain of its affiliated companies are federal, state, and/or local government contractors. Should this position support a Federal Government contract, now or in the future, the successful candidate will be subject to a background check conducted by the U.S. Government to determine eligibility and suitability for federal contract employment for public trust or sensitive positions. Positions that support state and/or local contracts also may require additional background checks to determine eligibility and suitability.
 
 
 Salary Range 
$90,000.00 - $144,000.00 
 
 These pay ranges apply to employees in New Jersey and New York. Pay ranges for employees in other states may differ. 
 
 It is unlawful to discriminate against a prospective employee due to the individual's status as a veteran. 
 
 
 
This position is not eligible for an annual incentive opportunity and is also not eligible to earn commissions. 
 
 Thank you for considering employment with Fiserv.  Please: 
 
 Apply using your legal name 
 Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable). 
 
 
 Our commitment to Equal Opportunity: 
 Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law. 
 
 If you have a disability and require a reasonable accommodation in completing a job application or otherwise participating in the overall hiring process, please contact  AskHR.US@fiserv.com . Please note our AskHR representatives do not have visibility to your application status. Current associates who require a workplace accommodation should refer to Fiserv’s Disability Accommodation Policy for additional information.
 
 Note to agencies: 
 Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
 
 Warning about fake job posts: 
 Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.
